authentication.notes: API token generated from the Smith.ai dashboard under Virtual Receptionist account settings. A separate API key exists for Outreach Campaigns plans. See https://docs.smith.ai/article/p4ea2x3sx6-generate-an-api-token

endpoints.purpose: Submit one or more leads for an outbound call by a Smith.ai human or AI receptionist. Receptionist calls the contact at callback_number, follows action_required instructions if answered, action_fallback if not. Supports retry cadence and custom availability windows.
endpoints.request_shape: application/json — JSON array of lead objects. Required: callback_number (string, E.164), reason (int 1-8), action_required (string max 500), action_fallback (string). Optional: first_name, last_name, email, send_summary_to, availability (1=24/7|2=business hours|3=custom), attempts (int, 0=unlimited), cadence_amount (int), cadence_unit (1=minutes|2=hours), custom_from (time string), custom_to (time string), custom_weekdays (object), custom_timezone (TZ string), reason_other_text (string max 200, required when reason=8)
endpoints.response_shape: 200 -> JSON confirmation of queued call request(s). Exact schema not publicly documented.
endpoints.python_example:
import requests
url = 'https://app.smith.ai/api/vr/v1/outbound/'
headers = {'Authorization': 'token YOUR_API_TOKEN', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
payload = [{'first_name': 'John', 'last_name': 'Smith', 'email': 'john@example.com', 'callback_number': '+16505554422', 'reason': 2, 'availability': 2, 'action_required': 'Follow outbound call instructions', 'action_fallback': 'Follow outbound call instructions', 'send_summary_to': 'owner@example.com'}]
response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
print(response.json())

endpoints.purpose: Add leads to an existing Outreach Campaign, triggering the campaign's outbound call sequence for those contacts. Uses a separate Outreach Campaigns API key. Exact path is inferred — see docs for confirmed URL.
endpoints.request_shape: application/json — lead contact object with first_name, last_name, email, phone, and any additional custom fields configured for the campaign. Campaign ID required in URL.
endpoints.response_shape: JSON confirmation. Exact schema not publicly documented.

user_selectable_params.name: reason
user_selectable_params.allowed_values: 1 (Spanish caller) | 2 (Schedule consultation) | 3 (Advise outside practice areas) | 4 (Collect payments) | 5 (Reschedule appointment) | 6 (Inform follow-up email sent) | 7 (Correct mistake) | 8 (Other)

user_selectable_params.name: attempts
user_selectable_params.allowed_values: integer (0 = unlimited retries until contact reached)

webhooks_or_events: No outbound webhooks from Smith.ai to caller. Call summaries are delivered via email, SMS, Slack, or Microsoft Teams as configured in the dashboard. No programmatic webhook registration via API.
pricing_summary: Virtual Receptionist: $300/mo (30 calls), $810/mo (90 calls), $2100/mo (300 calls). AI Receptionist: ~$95/mo (30 calls), overage ~$4.25/call. No free tier; 30-day money-back guarantee. Outreach Campaigns priced separately. Add-ons $0.25–$1.50/call.
